step1_analysis.description: The extracted netlist contains two PMOS transistors configured as a basic current mirror. While the paper describes a 5-6 GHz VCO, this specific sub-circuit is a DC bias block used to mirror a reference current for the core oscillator or buffer.

current_ratio.description: Ratio of the mirrored output current to the reference input current.

sky130_expected.reasoning: With identical W and L, the current ratio should be exactly 1, with minor deviations due to channel length modulation if Vds1 != Vds2.

output_resistance.description: Small-signal output resistance (Rout) of the current mirror.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using the typical channel length modulation parameter (lambda=0.1/V) for L=0.5um at a 10uA reference current.

vmax_compliance.description: Maximum output voltage before the output transistor leaves saturation (enters triode).

sky130_expected.reasoning: The PMOS requires a minimum Vsd (overdrive voltage, Vov) to remain in saturation. With VDD=1.8V and Vov~0.2V, Vmax is approximately 1.6V.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the current mirror.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 23mW for the entire VCO, but this isolated bias block consumes power based on the 10uA test current.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure current ratio, output resistance, compliance voltage, and power consumption of the PMOS current mirror.
step3_testbench.spice:
* PMOS Current Mirror Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

XM1 N3 N3 N8 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N5 N3 N8 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN8 N8 VDD 0
IREF N3 0 10u
VOUT N5 0 0.9

.control
  op
  let iref = 10u
  let iout = -i(VOUT)
  let current_ratio = iout / iref
  print current_ratio

  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  dc VOUT 0 1.8 0.01
  meas dc iout_900m find i(VOUT) at=0.9
  meas dc iout_1000m find i(VOUT) at=1.0
  let rout = 0.1 / (iout_1000m - iout_900m)
  print rout
  
  let target_iout = iout_900m * 0.95
  meas dc vmax_compliance when i(VOUT)=target_iout
  print vmax_compliance
  quit
.endc
.end
